notes: 44 requests: 12 partition screening, 12 budget screening, 20 paired requests.
Paired data: eight warm requests per route, one excluded first request per process.
System paging counters include other applications; zero swap-out does not imply zero swap-in.
Process footprint excludes other processes/Core ML services; lifetime max is not a per-request peak.
Application pread byte count is not measured physical SSD traffic.
P95 values are descriptive sample percentiles, not proven long-tail bounds.
Idle sleep inhibited, no deliberate cache flushing, interactive workstation.
MLComputePlan compiler preference is not observed runtime hardware residency.
No change to production runtime, App route validation, or user defaults in this experiment.
